author: ETA PRIME
description:
GPD just sent me a prototype of their craziest handheld yet — the GPD WIN Max 3. This isn't just a handheld, it's a modular handheld gaming PC / mini laptop hybrid with a swappable 97Wh "FlexPower" battery, a snap-in fan module for extra cooling, capacitive analog sticks, Hall effect triggers, and a stunning 9" 165Hz true RGB AMOLED display. In this first look I go hands-on with the design, the controls, the keyboard, the modular battery and fan system, the full spec sheet, and run some 3DMark benchmarks + real gameplay in Forza Horizon 6, Cyberpunk 2077, and Crimson Desert.
